description: Get a Helical connection working when it is not: the plugin was installed but never connected, a tool call came back with an authorization link, or a connection that worked before is now refused. Use when the helical tools are missing from the session or the host offers only an `authenticate` tool for it; when a Helical call returns "Authorization required before this tool can run", "This request requires more information" or a link to open; when it fails with invalid_grant, invalid_request, invalid_client, invalid_token, unauthorized_client, a 401, "OAuth authorization required", "Missing Bearer token" or "Invalid JWT"; when a call fails without saying why; or when the user asks how to sign in. For a run refused over credit, use check-credits.
